notes: Halves representation: In AstroYogi, half points are printed as decimals ('1.5'). In OnlineJyotish, half points are printed as the vulgar fraction '1/2' (for Nara-Jalachara and Jalachara-Nara), represented here numerically as 0.5.

Row/Column orientation: Both pages explicitly label the rows as 'Bride' and the columns as 'Groom' (OnlineJyotish places 'Bride \ Groom' in the top-left cell, while AstroYogi places 'Bride' above the row labels and 'Groom' spanning the top of the columns).

Headings terminology: AstroYogi uses 'Chatushpada', 'Human', 'Jalchar', 'Vanacara', and 'Keet', whereas OnlineJyotish uses the full Sanskrit forms 'Chatushpada', 'Nara', 'Jalachara', 'Vanachara', and 'Keeta'.

Points differences between grids: (1) Chatushpada-Vanacara is 1.5 in AstroYogi vs 0 in OnlineJyotish; (2) Human/Nara-Jalchar/Jalachara is 1.5 in AstroYogi vs 1/2 (0.5) in OnlineJyotish; (3) Jalchar/Jalachara-Human/Nara is 1.5 in AstroYogi vs 1/2 (0.5) in OnlineJyotish; (4) Vanacara/Vanachara-Jalchar/Jalachara is 0 in AstroYogi vs 1 in OnlineJyotish; (5) Keet/Keeta-Human/Nara is 1 in AstroYogi vs 0 in OnlineJyotish.
All cells were readable with complete confidence.
